findings.title: Script has Windows line endings
findings.cause: container worker exits because script /scripts/start.sh has Windows line endings (CRLF): the shell keeps each line's carriage return (\r) as part of the line's last word, so a command, an option or a path is not the one written; its log says: "/scripts/start.sh: cd: line 3: can't cd to /tmp\r: No such file or directory"; the script comes from ConfigMap worker-scripts; Deployment worker has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container worker exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 7 times
last lines of container worker's log (run that exited)
evidence.detail:
starting the worker
/scripts/start.sh: cd: line 3: can't cd to /tmp: No such file or directory
sleep: invalid number '3600'

evidence.what: container worker mounts volume scripts (ConfigMap worker-scripts) at /scripts

findings.fix: Save the script with Unix line endings (dos2unix, or `*.sh text eol=lf` in .gitattributes so a Windows checkout keeps them), then create ConfigMap worker-scripts again from the file.
